title: Bench pool rows ask about decisions the 2026-10-21 sweep invalidated, so their operator check cannot match
goal: every bench_pool.csv row that names a decision id names one whose status is decided in kb/_self/_decisions.csv, so its checks read an active operator decision

run: import csv,re,sys;st={r['id']:r['status'] for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/_self/_decisions.csv',encoding='utf-8'))};bad=[(r['id'],d) for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_retrieval/bench_pool.csv',encoding='utf-8')) for d in re.findall(r'D-[a-z0-9]{8}',r['question']) if st.get(d)!='decided'];print(bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

repro_reason: the defect is pool data out of step with the decision ledger; the repro joins the two files, as the fix's own pool rebuild must
